svg.title: einfile: guarantee levels
svg.desc: Level 0, the file, is built: per-device chains and seals checked from the file and public keys alone. Level 1, the anchor, has the format and seam built but the adapters live outside this repository. Level 2, settlement between organisations, is not built.
svg.text: Per-device chains and ML-DSA-65 seals, checked from the file and public keys alone. Merge of two copies.
Proves: nothing under a sealed tip changed since the key holder signed it. Not: that the event happened.
format + seam built, adapters not here
Outside evidence that a record existed by a moment: OpenTimestamps, a time-stamp authority, Roughtime.
Without it a rollback to an older honest file does not show. An anchor nobody checked counts as nothing.
Witnesses or a chain fixing the order between organisations that do not trust each other.
Each level is optional and reads the same file. No chain is ever required.
